control_contract.revoke_grant: Accepted immediately. Propagation completes after one or two advance ticks; the acknowledgment does not reveal which. Existing tokens and resource sessions persist.
control_contract.access_token: A token is live only while expires_at_tick > current_tick. A successful new mint at tick n expires at tick n + 2.
control_contract.terminate_session: Ends only the named resource session, not its parent token or grant.
control_contract.block_client: A permanent client-wide block immediately denies protected exports and all approved jobs, including signed standby work. It does not revoke grants, expire tokens, terminate sessions, or stop token minting. The acknowledgment is not containment or delivery proof.
control_contract.set_quarantine: Immediately blocks protected access for one user and this client, including approved current-runner work; it does not stop token minting. Release only after checking latent paths.
control_contract.assign_job: A ready runner needs a signed job authorization and free capacity for the due tick. Assignment acknowledgment is not delivery.
control_contract.advance: Apply revocations and expiries, attempt adversarial mint, check protected exports, then deliver due approved jobs. At most four ticks.
control_contract.dashboard: The derived grant-control feed may report effective=true at tick 1 after a revocation request. Use the live auth/resource probe for current capability.
control_contract.probe: Reports latent can_mint, live tokens, live sessions, quarantine, and protected-access fields without an authorization verdict.

initial.authorization_rule: A grant is authorized only by the published base rule or a registry row matching client/app, tenant, principal, every scope, approval route, and validity at issue_time. No per-grant verdict is supplied.
